```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

#### Loading data
```{r}
data <- read.csv("TCGA-PANCAN-HiSeq-801x20531/data.csv")
labels <- read.csv("TCGA-PANCAN-HiSeq-801x20531/labels.csv")

dim(data)
dim(labels)

data[1:5, 1:6]
head(labels)

# Checks: sample IDs line up, and no missing values
all(data[, 1] == labels[, 1])
sum(is.na(data))
sum(is.na(labels))
```

#### Exploration
```{r}
# 1. Target Class Frequency Distribution
class_table <- table(labels$Class)
class_df <- as.data.frame(class_table)
colnames(class_df) <- c("CancerType", "Count")

cat("Target Class Counts:\n")
class_df

ggplot(class_df, aes(x = reorder(CancerType, -Count), y = Count, fill = CancerType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), vjust = -0.3, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Figure 1: Sample Distribution Across 5 Primary Cancer Types",
       x = "Cancer Type", y = "Number of Samples")

# 2. Log2 Transformation: log2(x + 1)
Class <- factor(labels$Class)
gene_matrix <- data[, sapply(data, is.numeric)]   # drops the sample-ID column
expr_log <- log2(gene_matrix + 1)

summary(expr_log[, 1])

# 3. Variance filtering and PCA (all samples, for the exploratory plot only)
gene_vars_all <- apply(expr_log, 2, var)
top_1000_all <- head(order(gene_vars_all, decreasing = TRUE), 1000)
pca_all <- prcomp(expr_log[, top_1000_all], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_all$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_all$x[, 2],
  CancerType = Class
)
var_explained <- round(summary(pca_all)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100, 1)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = CancerType)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Figure 2: 2D PCA Projection of Top Variable Genes",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "% Variance)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "% Variance)"),
       color = "Cancer Type")
```

#### Train/test split and preprocessing for modeling (training data only)
```{r}
library(MASS)       
library(class)
library(e1071)
library(nnet)
library(randomForest)

set.seed(1)
train <- sample(1:nrow(expr_log), 560)            # about 70%
test  <- (1:nrow(expr_log))[-train]
Class.train <- Class[train]
Class.test  <- Class[test]

# Variance filter and PCA using ONLY the training rows
gene_vars <- apply(expr_log[train, ], 2, var)
top_genes <- order(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE)[1:1000]
pr.out <- prcomp(expr_log[train, top_genes], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# PC scores: training from the PCA, test projected with the same PCA
train.pc30 <- pr.out$x[, 1:30]
test.pc30  <- predict(pr.out, expr_log[test, top_genes])[, 1:30]

dim(train.pc30); dim(test.pc30)
table(Class.train); table(Class.test)
```
